title: The Penalty (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal football tension
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Twelve yards
One man with the ball
One man with no instructions except to stop it
And eighty thousand people who have already decided
What's going to happen

[Verse 2]
The goalkeeper dives before the kick
Eighty percent of the time he guesses wrong
The kicker knows this
The goalkeeper knows the kicker knows this
The crowd knows none of this
And screams anyway

[Chorus]
The penalty is the loneliest moment in football
One decision
One direction
And the moment it leaves the boot
Nothing can bring it back
Not even regret

[Bridge]
Chas said — the penalty tells you everything about a person
Not who they are when they score
Who they are when they step up knowing they might not
That's the test
Twelve yards is a very long walk when the whole world is watching

[Verse 3]
Some players kiss their boots
Some stare at the ball for a long time
Some run straight at it like they've already decided in the tunnel
Chas always watched the goalkeeper's eyes
Said — the keeper already knows where it's going
The kicker just hasn't told himself yet

[Outro]
The penalty
The penalty
That's my boy
